about.title: About BAC
about.intro: BUSINESS & ADVICE CONSULTANTS SARL, an auditing, consulting, and Approved Management Center, registered under number 0000762/MINFI/DGI/LRI/CSR on September 30, 2024.
about.description: BAC specializes in intellectual service delivery. It was founded by highly qualified experts with over twenty years of professional experience in major firms, national and multinational companies operating in Cameroon.

cga.title: What is an Approved Management Center (CGA)?
cga.description: An Approved Management Center (CGA) provides technical assistance to industrial, commercial, artisanal, and agricultural businesses.
points: Assists in financial and economic risk prevention
Provides tax assistance and compliance support

about.availability: BAC and its team are available 24/7 to assist clients under the supervision of Jean TCHINDA.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Our mission is to increase the added value of our trusted clients, contribute to risk management, and enhance the performance of their businesses.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: We want to help economic operators work with tax and legal peace of mind, rather than negotiating to avoid complications. This is why we take the time to know our clients well once they place their trust in us.

team.title: Our Team
team.description: Our Uniqueness Lies in Our Experience. Under the leadership of Mr. Tchinda Jean, our team is composed of top experts in accounting, taxation, and more..

manager.name: Jean TCHINDA
manager.certifications: CEMAC Licensed Tax Consultant S/N° 395, registered with ONCFC S/N° 24 204

services.title: Our Services
services.description: Offers a full range of services to businesses as well as public organizations and institutions.
services.audit: Audit and Financial Review in Partnership

specialties.title: Our Areas of Expertise
specialties.description: Our entity is composed of the following independent professions:

fiscal_advice.title: Tax Consulting
points: Tax Optimization: Legally Contributing to the Reduction of the Client's Tax Burden.
Tax Strategy: Identifying the Company's Future Tax Risks.
Tax Filing Management: Preparing and submitting tax returns.

legal_advice.title: Legal Consulting
points: Corporate Law: Company creation, mergers, acquisitions, and liquidation.
Contracts: Drafting and reviewing commercial, employment, and partnership contracts.
Litigation: Representing clients in tax and legal disputes.

audit.title: Audit and Financial Review in Partnership

accounting.title: Preliminary Accounting Management
items: Accounting entry processing
Recording and bookkeeping
Setting up extra-accounting files (asset tracking, cost calculation, etc.)
Bank reconciliations
Establishment of interest rate schedules
Periodic Account Review
Preparation of Periodic Financial Statements
Accounting recovery
Inventory and cash count assistance
Preparation and submission of the Statistical and Tax Declaration (DSF)

employment.title: Payroll Management and Assistance
items: Payroll Processing for Employees
Preparation of Monthly and Annual Social Contribution Declarations
Assistance with social security audits
Assistance with Labor Department Inspections
Labor law consulting (recruitment, dismissal, personnel management, etc.)

tax.title: Tax Assistance
items: Technical Responses to Oral or Written Taxation Inquiries
Preparation of Monthly, Periodic, and Annual Tax Declarations
Tax optimization (advising on planned operations and decisions)
Tax management for foreigners

assistance.title: Legal Assistance
items: Answers to oral and written legal questions
Legal consultations on Business Law (Corporate Law, Social Law, Contract Law)

secretariat.title: Legal Secretariat
items: Drafting minutes of Board of Directors and General Meetings (ordinary and extraordinary)
Drafting reports for Auditors (general and special reports, meeting summaries, etc.)
Completion of legal formalities

management_center.title: Approved Management Center
items: Membership registrations
Transmission of files to the DGI
Bookkeeping on request
Tax filing on request
Providing additional services upon request

non_residents.title: Non-Resident Management
items: Drafting employment contracts for foreigners
Visa and residence permit formalities
Annual tax declaration for foreign income

annual_tax_regulation.title: Annual Parafiscal Adjustment
items: Annual Payroll Audit, Tax, and Social Contribution Adjustment
Annual Audit of Employer’s Compliance with Tax and Social Obligations
Review of Salary Deduction Calculation Methods
Verify the Tax Regime for Salary Supplements (Allowances, Benefits in Kind, etc.)

dsf_tax_review.title: Tax Audit of the Annual Financial Statement (DSF)
items: Audit of the Fixed Assets and Provisions Schedule
Final reconciliation of VAT at year-end
Audit of the Proper Settlement of Deductions and Utilization of Tax Benefits
Audit of the Settlement of the Company's Debts
Highlighting tax risks based on provided documents and issuing recommendations
Assessment of the Company's Tax Savings

foreign_exchange.title: Customs Assistance and Foreign Exchange Control
items: Support in import and export operations
Assistance with customs audits
Compliance support for foreign exchange controls (Ministry of Finance and BEAC)
Support for Income Transfer

agency_services.title: Assistance in Organizational Management
items: Implementation of internal control procedures to prevent fraud in accounting and financial management
Fair Distribution of Roles Among Governance Bodies
Establishment of Rules for Executive Compensation Transparency
Employee Participation in Company Management

transfer_pricing.title: Transfer Pricing Assistance
items: Implementation of a corporate transfer pricing policy
Providing legal security for pricing agreements (advance pricing agreement, bilateral or unilateral agreements)
Assistance in preparing transfer pricing documentation
Support during tax audits focused on transfer pricing

tax_disputes.title: Assistance with Tax Audits and Litigation

pieces_control.title: Desk Audit Assistance
items: Assessment of the Desk Audit Procedure
Review of requested clarifications and justifications
Minimization of potential tax risks

onsite_control.title: On-Site Tax Audit Assistance
items: Preparation and organization of tax audits
Structuring and managing accounting teams for audit readiness
Support for companies during on-site tax inspections
Presentation and justification of company tax positions to authorities
Assessment of financial risks related to tax liabilities

administrative_procedure.title: Administrative Tax Procedure Support
items: Proposing solutions and preparing responses to preliminary tax adjustment notices
Assessment of the Issues Raised by the Tax Inspector
Drafting responses to tax adjustments considered by the tax administration
Assisting with tax dispute procedures in company offices and at the Tax Center before final tax adjustments

preliminary_appeal.title: Preliminary Appeal before Tax Administration
items: Managing tax disputes before the Directorate General of Taxes (DGI)
Handling tax disputes before the Ministry of Finance (MINFI)
Tax settlement negotiations before the tax authorities if necessary (Art.L125 of Cameroon’s Tax Code)

judicial_appeal.title: Judicial Tax Litigation Assistance
items: Filing appeals before the Administrative Court
Legal representation and case follow-up
Etc...
